meta.source: FlyWire whole-brain connectome (FAFB female adult fly brain), proofread connections plus the Schlegel 2024 cell-type annotations
meta.release: FlyWire 783 (materialization 783); connections Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10676866 v783.0; annotations flywire_annotations v3.2.0, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23037340
meta.licence: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as stated on both Zenodo record pages
meta.animal: FlyWire FAFB: one adult female Drosophila melanogaster. A different individual from the hemibrain fly.
meta.hemisphere: right (KCs with soma side "right" in the Schlegel 2024 annotations; the hemibrain MB is also the right one)
meta.units: micrometres in FAFB14.1 space (voxel 4 x 4 x 40 nm), not hemibrain space; pos = soma when annotated, else the anchor; cen = the FlyWire anchor point on the neurite backbone, NOT a cable centroid
meta.idsAre: strings (FlyWire 783 root ids have 18 digits, past the JS safe integer range)
notes: Wiring is the real FlyWire 783 synapse counts between the selected neurons, summed over neuropils, filtered by the same thresholds as the hemibrain file.
FlyWire synapses come from automatic detection (Buhmann 2021); hemibrain counts come from a different pipeline. Equal thresholds do not mean equal biological strength.

Cell types come from the hemibrain_type column of the Schlegel 2024 annotations (flywire_annotations v3.2.0). Compartments come from hemibrain instance names of the same type, because FlyWire has no instance names.
MBON valence is the same model rule as the hemibrain file: +1 for PPL1-dominated compartments, -1 for PAM-dominated, 0 for ties and the calyx.
KCs with no uniglomerular PN input stay in the set with no pn_kc edges.

compareHemibrain.note: Same summary computed from data/connectome.json (hemibrain v1.2, right MB) by compareStats in this tool.
